original_description: Scaffolds the plugin that carries other components — the directory tree, a valid `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, the marketplace entry, and `claude plugin validate --strict` until it passes. Use when the plugin itself is the artifact: starting one, deciding which surfaces it must reach, adding a component directory, or fixing a plugin whose components are not loading and the manifest or layout is suspected. Do not use to write the components themselves — skill-creator, agent-creator, hook-creator, mcp-creator and command-creator each own their own artifact, and this skill hands off to them. Do not use to review an existing component's quality: the five reviewer agents do that read-only.

final_description:
Use when the artifact being built or fixed is a Claude Code **plugin package** itself: starting a new plugin, choosing which components (skills, agents, hooks, commands, MCP) it should bundle, laying out the directory tree, writing or repairing `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and the marketplace entry, and looping on `claude plugin validate --strict`. Also use when a plugin's components silently fail to load, paths break after install, or names collide — anything traceable to the manifest, layout, or plugin-root anchoring.

Do not use for authoring or reviewing a single component — skill-creator, agent-creator, hook-creator, mcp-creator and command-creator own those, and the reviewer agents audit them. Do not use for questions about *operating* a plugin rather than building one: enterprise or admin settings, fleet policy and permission precedence, enabling or distributing an already-built plugin, or packaging for surfaces that take a different artifact (MCPB bundles, remote connectors).
